summary: Official Skill Boundary P0 — 技能隔离体系
approach: SkillRegistry 扩展为双 BaseDirectory 扫描（RESOURCE + APPDATA），SkillMeta 新增 source: 'official' | 'custom' 标记。先扫描 Official 再扫描 Custom，冲突时保留 Official 跳过 Custom。tauri resource 已配置。调用方（skillBridge）零修改。

data_flow.diagram: SkillRegistry(dual BaseDirectory) -> getAllSkills() merged -> skillBridge -> chat
stages: 1. SkillRegistry 初始化时持有 officialBaseDir + customBaseDir
2. discoverSkills() 先扫描 Official 目录
3. 再扫描 Custom 目录，冲突时保留 Official 跳过 Custom
5. skillBridge 和 MentionPopup 无需修改

design_decisions: OSB1: 双 BaseDirectory 合并 — 单 Registry 实例，调用方透明
OSB2: Official 优先 — Custom 冲突时跳过并 warning log，不允许 shadow
OSB3: tauri resource 已配置 resources.skills/ + fs scope — 无需修改
OSB4: SkillMeta.source 由 Registry 自动填充，非 skill.json 字段

patterns: SkillRegistry 现有 lazy init + cache 模式不变
SkillLoader 现有 sanitizeSkillId 模式不变
conventions: Official Skill 目录位于 $RESOURCE/skills/ (BuiltIn only)
冲突规则: Official 优先, Custom 冲突时跳过 + warning log
tauri.conf.json 已含 resources.skills/* + fs scope $RESOURCE/skills/**

confidence.notes: 单 task，3 files，tauri 配置已就绪，无碰撞风险
